_comment: Goal U10: the historical t8n cases Jaune refuses. Every fork they name is declared but unimplemented (Fork.rules? is none), so `jaune t8n` fails before reading any input with UnsupportedForkError, exactly as `lake exe jaune --rules <fork>` does. These cases are never marked passing: the gate requires the refusal, with this reason, and the goldens (generated from the pinned target) record the behavior U11 will conform to.
